title: Behavior Graphs: Unsupervised Graph Structures for Interpreting Robot Deployment Data
summary: On three robot audit tasks, behavior graphs lowered perceived time demand and effort for 16 of 18 participants; the comparison did not reliably establish unchanged decision quality. The result is limited to this presentation workflow.
ai_technology: Behavior-graph clustering of robot policy embeddings
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: On three robot audit tasks, behavior graphs lowered perceived time demand and effort for 16 of 18 participants; the comparison did not reliably establish unchanged decision quality. The result is limited to this presentation workflow.
evidence.unknown: 18-participant user study on three real-world tasks; separate progress-estimation comparisons across 43 datasets
evidence.ai_role: policy embeddings are clustered into behavior modes and linked in a graph for rollout inspection and data-collection decisions.
